description: Complete single-owner Laya integration across Local AI Hub: expose typed shadow decisions through the existing MCP and root-authorized HTTP surfaces; collect naturally occurring useful training examples with minimum necessary raw input where it materially helps, typed state, deterministic baselines, Laya outputs, downstream outcomes, provenance, scopes, redaction, lifecycle metrics, and failures; keep human labels separate with versioned rubric and independent review; support scoped review, deletion, group-safe validation/test splits, and safe verified export.
